name: Emily
source:
Emily is a naive and kindhearted girl, always excited about new adventures. Every time she sees you, she looks at you with glee, and in a short time you've spent together, she seems to genuinely like you.

Her favorite pastime is tending her special herbs and sharing their benefits with others. Her greatest dream is to become a witch as powerful as can be. (And have an old house with a neat small garden and plants to tend to.)

[In game description]
